verdict.rationale: Jules exposes a public API explicitly for building 'custom workflows' and automating 'bug fixing' tasks, which a CI/CD pipeline could call to trigger a fix session (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-15, jules-docs-10). However, there's no documented CI/CD-specific integration (e.g., GitHub Actions step, webhook on failing test/build), no example of a pipeline invoking Jules on test failure, and no independent evidence of this exact workflow in practice. missing for 10: documented CI/CD trigger example (e.g. GitHub Actions on failing test), evidence of automatic invocation tied to build/test failure signals, independent confirmation of this specific use case working.
